notes: Normalized output names; source files are preserved.
itemIds are direct equipment identities; appearanceOf describes shared art or visual ancestry, not equivalent equipment.
Colors describe visible artwork; NGC and skin labels do not prove Ephinea availability.
Byte-identical files share one asset; visually similar but different files remain separate.
Unresolved assets must not be assigned to item pages.
